details: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved the first U.S.-listed Bitcoin perpetual futures contracts. This regulatory milestone allows Coinbase to offer American traders access to global crypto derivatives markets, enhancing regulatory integration for a highly liquid segment of the crypto ecosystem within the US.
title: US CFTC Approves First Bitcoin Perpetual Futures

details: The Sui blockchain suffered additional downtime on May 29, following a prior six-hour outage on May 28. The network's block production and transaction processing have since been restored, with the issue attributed to a software bug. This marks another interruption for the Sui network within a short period.
title: Sui Blockchain Experiences Second Outage in Months

details: Institutional investors are consistently withdrawing funds from Bitcoin, with spot BTC Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recording significant outflows. Over the past two weeks, cumulative crypto outflows have reached $2.54 billion, indicating a sustained decrease in institutional interest in Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Continued Institutional Outflows

details: A drafted 60-day ceasefire memorandum between the US and Iran pushed traditional markets higher on May 28, but Bitcoin's price remained flat below $73,000. This suggests a decoupling of Bitcoin from traditional risk-on sentiment, with the broader crypto market exhibiting a "fear" sentiment despite positive geopolitical news.
title: Bitcoin Unaffected by US-Iran Ceasefire Draft

details: Texas has appointed executives from CleanSpark and CEOs of Bitcoin mining companies to its Strategic Bitcoin Reserve committee. This initiative is part of the proposed "American Reserve Modernisation Act of 2026," aiming to secure the state's existing crypto holdings for 20 years.
title: Texas Advances Plans for Strategic Bitcoin Reserve

details: Aave Labs has obtained dual licenses from the UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) through its local subsidiary. This regulatory approval enables Aave to provide regulated crypto payment infrastructure and services within the United Kingdom market, signaling expansion and increased legitimacy.
title: Aave Labs Secures FCA Approval for UK Operations

details: On-chain analytics firm Lookonchain reported a transfer of 411.48 BTC (approximately $30.3 million) from a "Strategy" wallet to Coinbase Prime. This move has ignited speculation among crypto investors and in prediction markets about a potential sale by this large holder before the end of the month.
title: 'Strategy' Wallet Moves Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime

details: XRP experienced a nearly 6% weekly drop as traders seemingly shifted capital to Stellar (XLM). This rotation follows news of a partnership between DTCC and Stellar, which aims for a 2027 launch of tokenized DTC securities, boosting confidence in XLM.
title: XRP Falls as Traders Rotate to Stellar (XLM)

details: Fidelity analysts suggest that the escalating demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure might lead Bitcoin miners to redirect their power resources towards AI operations. This shift could potentially flatten the growth of Bitcoin's network hash rate in 2026, influencing mining strategies.
title: AI Demand Could Affect Bitcoin Hash Rate Growth

details: Kalshi, a regulated prediction market exchange, has filed a federal lawsuit against Minnesota. The suit aims to prevent the enforcement of what Kalshi alleges is the first ban on prediction markets in the United States, highlighting ongoing legal and regulatory challenges for the industry.
title: Kalshi Sues Minnesota Over Prediction Market Ban
